name: Aegis Download Inspector
description: Inspects download metadata (filenames, double extensions, RTLO, risky extensions) and maintains an audit log of flagged downloads.
notes: Permission justification: downloads permission is required to observe download metadata in downloads.onCreated and pause suspicious downloads. storage is required to maintain local audit log of flagged downloads and kill-switch state. Note: live hook inspects metadata only (filenames/extensions) because WebExtensions lack filesystem byte access without host permissions. Operates strictly offline with zero network transmissions (Privacy Class P1).
